title: Everyday Phrases — A Bike-Share Ride
scene_zh: 共享單車 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚲 實用共享單車必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Bike-Share Ride
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用共享單車情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從下載 App、註冊繳押金、掃碼解鎖，到騎車找車道、找停車點，再到鏈條鬆了、鎖不上、顯示錯誤計費異常，最後確實落鎖結束行程、辦月卡、注意安全再出發，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Bike-Share Ride phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering downloading the app, signing up, scanning to unlock, finding bike lanes and docks, a dropped chain, a broken lock, an app error and billing problem, then proper locking, a monthly pass, and riding safely. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try a bike-share today.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天來試騎共享單車吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, but I need the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə bət aɪ nid ði æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bike-share app should I use?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ baɪk ʃɛr æp ʃʊd aɪ juːz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one works all over the city.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn wɜrks ɔl ˈoʊvər ðə ˈsɪti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it free to download?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just search the app store.
dialogue.zh: 免費，去應用商店搜一下就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I found it right here.
dialogue.zh: 好，我就在這兒找到它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now tap the install button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my email address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter it and create your account.
dialogue.zh: 填進去，再註冊你的賬號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign up with my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ saɪn ʌp wɪð maɪ foʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a text code is faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It came fast, six digits long.
dialogue.zh: 驗證碼馬上來了，六位數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it into the box now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says the code was wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again and watch the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This time it logged me in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, you are almost ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next it wants a payment method.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Link your card or mobile pay.
dialogue.zh: 綁銀行卡或手機支付就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to pay a deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu peɪ ə dɪˈpɑzɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some bikes need one, some don't.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It holds a hundred yuan here.
dialogue.zh: 它在這兒凍結了一百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That money returns after your ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set, I accept the terms.
dialogue.zh: 搞定了，我同意這些條款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your account is ready.
dialogue.zh: 很好，你的賬號開通好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find a bike?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the map on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, so many green icons.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are bikes near our street.
dialogue.zh: 那些就是我們這條街附近的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that bike far from us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is two blocks away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I reserve it first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the bike and press hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ðə baɪk ænd prɛs hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 可以，點那輛車再按保留。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says reserved for ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's walk there before it ends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, my arrow just turned blue.
dialogue.zh: 噢，我的箭頭剛好變藍色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means you face the right way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ju feɪs ðə raɪt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這代表你面朝正確方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, by the café.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that was the closest one.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那是最近的一輛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one looks a bit dirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the seat and the handles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the QR code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the frame, near the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə freɪm nɪr ðə wiəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I scan it with this app?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ skæn ɪt wɪð ðɪs æp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the scan button first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My camera is slow to focus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold your phone steady and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It scanned on my very first try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt skænd ɑn maɪ ˈvɛri fɜrst traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我頭一次試就掃碼成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now press unlock bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happened to the bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen for a small clicking sound.
dialogue.zh: 聽一下有沒有喀噠一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, I heard a click!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the lock is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app says the trip started.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The meter starts right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I check the brakes first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always test them before you ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the front brake feels loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the back one too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seat height feels all wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a lever under it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, now my legs fit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your feet should touch the ground.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this bike have a basket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small one on the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə smɔl wʌn ɑn ðə frʌnt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these bikes come with helmets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most apps do not offer one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wear my own then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, it is safer that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, the bell is broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ðə bɛl ɪz ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 對了，這輛車的鈴鐺壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just call out to warn people.
dialogue.zh: 喊一聲提醒前面的人就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh, this tire feels soft.
dialogue.zh: 噢，這條輪胎感覺有點軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it with your thumb.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this one is firm enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is fine to ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this bike-share cheap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first half hour costs very little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði fɜrst hæf ˈaʊər kɔsts ˈvɛri ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 頭半小時花不了多少錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I ride over an hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ raɪd ˈoʊvər ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 如果我騎超過一小時呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then each extra minute adds cost.
dialogue.zh: 那每多一分鐘就多算錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay after the trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it takes money automatically.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me pull out from the curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊl aʊt frʌm ðə kɜrb/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look behind before you move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone needs a holder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not hold it while riding.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will go in my back pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl ɡoʊ ɪn maɪ bæk ˈpɑkɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the screen to silent then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the pedals feel a bit stiff.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈpɛdəlz fil ə bɪt stɪf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They loosen after a few blocks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off we go, I found the lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf wi ɡoʊ aɪ faʊnd ðə leɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride slow and stay upright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, the wind is strong today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean forward and keep pedaling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A station is coming up ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can stop there soon.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們很快能在那停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's swing by that station now.
dialogue.zh: 我們順路去那個停車點看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go slow, I am right behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ sloʊ aɪ æm raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, this station looks packed.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個停車點看起來好擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip it, the river path is quieter.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ɪt ðə ˈrɪvər pæθ ɪz ˈkwaɪətər/
dialogue.zh: 別停那兒，河邊小路更安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am riding along the river path.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈraɪdɪŋ əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈrɪvər pæθ/
dialogue.zh: 我正沿著河邊的小路騎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That path is smooth and safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows my route in blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz maɪ ruːt ɪn blu/
dialogue.zh: App把我的路線顯示成藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow it to the next turn.
dialogue.zh: 照著它騎到下一個轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I turn left at the light?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tɜrn lɛft æt ðə laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我在紅綠燈那兒左轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wait for the walk sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the light is red now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop behind the white line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cars pass me on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them lots of room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A taxi pulled out too fast.
dialogue.zh: 有輛出租車衝出來太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you okay? Did it hit you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju oʊˈkeɪ dɪd ɪt hɪt ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I just braked hard.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我只是急剎了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, stay near the curb.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lane only for bikes?
dialogue.zh: 這條道是自行車專用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sign shows a bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is walking in my lane.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down and ring your bell.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bell still does not work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say excuse me as you pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh, the lane ended at a bus stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ðə leɪn ˈɛndɪd æt ə bʌs stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 呃，車道到公交站就斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Merge into the road behind it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I share the road with cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ ʃɛr ðə roʊd wɪð kɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 現在我和汽車共用這條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride in a straight, clear line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app says turn right ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your mirror, then move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bike has no mirror at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs baɪk hæz noʊ ˈmɪrər æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這輛車根本沒有後視鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just glance over your shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This street looks so steep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the low gear up the hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə loʊ ɡɪr ʌp ðə hɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the low gear again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small number on the shifter.
dialogue.zh: 變速器上小的那個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Going down, I feel too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap both brakes, not one.
dialogue.zh: 輕點兩個剎車，別只點一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands hurt on the grips.
dialogue.zh: 我的手握著把手有點疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax your arms a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I passed the wrong exit.
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我騎過該轉的路口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app will reroute you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It added three more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is not so bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the map wants a left turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə mæp wɑnts ə lɛft tɜrn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the small alley there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the alley safe at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay on the bright main road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My light is not very bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it on before it is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ɑn bɪˈfɔr ɪt ɪz dɑrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the battery light is blinking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride to a stand right now.
dialogue.zh: 現在就騎去一個停車點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the next stand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under a kilometer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, people at the docks ahead.
dialogue.zh: 看，前面停車樁那兒有人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we are almost there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the bikes in use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, empty docks are open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stand is very busy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for a slot with a green light.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ə slɑt wɪð ə ɡrin laɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is one glowing green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push your bike in till it clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ʊr baɪk ɪn tɪl ɪt klɪks/
dialogue.zh: 把車推進去，聽到喀噠為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will not go into the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl nɑt ɡoʊ ˈɪntu ðə slɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Line up the wheel with the dock.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn ʌp ðə wiəl wɪð ðə dɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the front wheel fits.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the handlebar down firmly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard the click this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the app to confirm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows the ride is ending.
dialogue.zh: 上面顯示行程快結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the final receipt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lock glows green now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the bike is docked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my ride stop the meter?
dialogue.zh: 我的行程把計費停了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it says trip closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It charged me two yuan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two yuan is nothing, right?
dialogue.zh: 兩塊錢根本不算什麼吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only fifteen minutes on the clock.
dialogue.zh: 時鐘上明明才十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the short trip is cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I see my history?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap your profile at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my list of rides.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each one shows time and cost.
dialogue.zh: 每一條都顯示時間和費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rate this bike?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stars are at the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I gave it five stars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it was a fine bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I want a coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The café is across the street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me lock my phone first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I can watch your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪ kæn wɑtʃ ʊr bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, you are a good friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, let's go inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel tired already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab a chair and rest there.
dialogue.zh: 找把椅子在那兒歇會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Riding beats sitting in traffic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, and it is good exercise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to return the helmet?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu rɪˈtɜrn ðə ˈhɛlmət/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one is your own.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, I brought it myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it with your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I liked riding by the river.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do it next weekend.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But can we do one more short ride?
dialogue.phonetic: /bət kæn wi du wʌn mɔr ʃɔrt raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 但我們能再騎一趟短的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, flat route only, no hills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This new bike feels different.
dialogue.zh: 這輛新車感覺不太一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a bad way, maybe?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pedals spin but nothing moves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, your chain came off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the chain is on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə tʃeɪn ɪz ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not try to fix it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt traɪ tu fɪks ɪt hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pants got a grease mark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with a tissue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, none in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take a napkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. What do I do now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Report the broken bike first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the report button?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under trip problems.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a list of issues.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap broken chain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for a photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one of the chain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The photo uploaded fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you can end the ride.
dialogue.zh: 現在你可以結束行程了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pushed it to a dock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try to lock the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lock will not close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Line it up with the hole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It pushed in but never clicked.
dialogue.zh: 我推進去了，但沒聽到喀噠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lock is bent, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app still says riding.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it is charging.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer keeps going up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the end trip button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows an error message.
dialogue.zh: 它跳出了一個錯誤提示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it to me, word by word.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt tu mi wɜrd baɪ wɜrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says lock failed, retry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move to another dock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next slot is blocked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the one on the far end.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə wʌn ɑn ðə fɑr ɛnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still the same error.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us call the support line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find their number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in the help menu.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, dialing right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have your trip code ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone picked up the call.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them the bike is broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chain fell, and it won't lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃeɪn fɛl ænd ɪt woʊnt lɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also say you are still charged.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asks for the bike number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is printed on the frame.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The number is eight zero two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the rest too, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is typing very fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is opening a case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says stay by the bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not leave it yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will this take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe ten or fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ride is still running.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him about the meter too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says he can see it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for a cost freeze.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He agreed to pause the charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, that is a relief.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A repair worker is coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point out which dock you use.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, I told him my street name.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn aɪ toʊld hɪm maɪ strit neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了，我告訴他我那條街的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He should arrive soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here he is, in an orange vest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr hi ɪz ɪn ən ˈɔrɪndʒ vɛst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Explain the chain and the lock.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說明鏈子和鎖的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He put the chain back fast.
dialogue.zh: 他很快把鏈子裝回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now test the pedals again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It spins smooth now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try closing the lock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lock still will not close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says the lock is broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how do I end my trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ du aɪ ɛnd maɪ trɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him to force it closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He has a tool for that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the app while he works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trip changed to closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the charge stop too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it says final cost zero.
dialogue.zh: 停了，最終費用顯示零元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you paid nothing for a bad bike?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju peɪd ˈnʌθɪŋ fər ə bæd baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 所以你等於沒為壞車花錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, he cancelled that fee.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他把那費用取消了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He was quite nice about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He also tagged the bike.
dialogue.zh: 他還給這輛車做了標記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now others will not rent it.
dialogue.zh: 這樣別人就租不到它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was a scary minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you handled it well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, lesson learned anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always check the bike first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check the chain next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃɛk ðə tʃeɪn nɛkst taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the lock, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are dirty again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a sink in the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə sɪŋk ɪn ðə stɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I need soap badly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash and dry them well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better. Let's get moving.
dialogue.zh: 舒服多了，我們繼續走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next stand is close by.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One sec, saving the case number.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我先存個工單號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep it just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rent a fresh bike now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在再租一輛新車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, check it with your hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chain is on, the tires are firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃeɪn ɪz ɑn ðə ˈtaɪərz ɑr fɜrm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the lock is fine too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, one scan and it unlocked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, a good bike is easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear my helmet tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one finger of space.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, snug but not sore.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I ride, road or lane?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ raɪd roʊd ɔr leɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the lane if it is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə leɪn ɪf ɪt ɪz klɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I show a turn?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold out your hand, flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left arm out for a left turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ɑrm aʊt fər ə lɛft tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 左手臂伸出來就是左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right arm for the other way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stop at a yellow light?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stɑp æt ə ˈjɛloʊ laɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop if it is safe to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never ride through a red one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, wait for your green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, I want a monthly pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ aɪ wɑnt ə ˈmʌnθli pæs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It saves money if you ride a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt seɪvz ˈmʌni ɪf ju raɪd ə lɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is thirty yuan a month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that include long rides?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only the first ride half hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈoʊnli ðə fɜrst raɪd hæf ˈaʊər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So longer rides still cost.
dialogue.zh: 那超過部分還是要付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but at a lower rate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I buy the pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the membership tab.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the monthly plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press buy and confirm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks to renew each month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can turn that off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will switch it off now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wɪl swɪtʃ ɪt ɔf naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, no surprise charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pass is active today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now your rides cost less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's finish this ride right.
dialogue.zh: 我們把這次行程好好結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park inside a legal zone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a legal zone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The marked spots on the map.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, a blue zone right here.
dialogue.zh: 噢，就在這兒有個藍色區域。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is good to stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave it by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that blocks the walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will move it inside the lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl muv ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə laɪnz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now lock the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, the lock goes down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a small tug.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It holds, it did not open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now end it in the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I press end trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the summary screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows the ride details.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the time and the fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, no charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your pass covered it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pass already saved me money today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pæs ɔlˈrɛdi seɪvd mi ˈmʌni təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 月卡今天就幫我省到錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride daily and it pays off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lock light off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check once more, be sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is dark and locked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the trip is closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take a photo?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, snap the parked bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, a photo for proof.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That protects you later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it save to my trips?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look in your history.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I feel confident.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did every step well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Riding here is really easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus it is good for the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs ɪt ɪz ɡʊd fər ði ɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No traffic, no waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bike is often faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's ride home this way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you stay awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am wide awake now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then scan a bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one unlocked right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do your two-second check.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brakes good, seat good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you are safe to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ride slow near the kids.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ring and give them room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rɪŋ ænd ɡɪv ðɛm rum/
dialogue.zh: 我會按鈴，給他們讓出空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That stop light is changing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ease off and be ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I stopped before the line.
dialogue.zh: 好，我在停止線前停住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, nice and clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green is on, let's move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pedal steady, no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are almost at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a stand ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will dock and lock it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ wɪl dɑk ænd lɑk ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then end the ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Locked, ended, zero fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a bike-pro now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to ride again tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring your helmet.
